## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL; Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Mixed internals — sector-level strength but major divergence in Big Tech (many names with 1W up vs 1M down) and narrow top-stock leadership, so no clear directional bias.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare lead: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND. Technology showing short-term strength but mixed signals: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY. Financials solid: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate showing weakness: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5 SP100 movers: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, IBM (1W: +12.10% | 1M: -12.06%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Worst 5 SP100: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION, INTC (1W: -9.42% | 1M: +11.51%) CORRECTION, CAT (1W: -8.84% | 1M: +5.90%) CORRECTION, T (1W: -8.21% | 1M: -16.48%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in pockets of Technology and Communication.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
1W leaders inside SP100: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY. Major divergence present: multiple mega-cap Tech names show 1W up / 1M down — this is a MAJOR divergence, so treat as tactical, not confirmation of a new regime.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Technology mixed: many large-cap Tech in RECOVERY (AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, GOOGL (1W: +4.71% | 1M: -0.48%) RECOVERY) while leaders like PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND show strength; sector-level 1W +3.19% but 1M -8.16% — internal rotation and short-term rebound.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Financials constructive: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION; sector 1W +2.69% with healthy pockets of ABOVE TREND names supporting risk appetite.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthcare leading on the week: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND; sector 1W +4.42% and showing broad strength.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor exposure to pockets of Financials and Healthcare that are ABOVE TREND (MA, V, JNJ, LLY) and monitor Technology RECOVERY names for confirmation before committing; reduce exposure to clear BELOW TREND Utilities/Real Estate names (VST, DLR). Style: mixed / no clear leadership given narrow top-stock concentration and major Tech divergence.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION — watch for follow-through or further unwind.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth strong; JNJ, LLY ABOVE TREND). BEARISH: Utilities and Real Estate (1W weakness; VST, DLR BELOW TREND) — watch for defensive rotation if weakness broadens.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
PANW above recent breakout needed to confirm continuation (ABOVE TREND to sustain). AAPL support band to watch on any retracement while in RECOVERY (AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY). QCOM downside continuation below the recent swing low would reinforce BELOW TREND risk.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
JPM (+80): Dividend/buyback headline; JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION — longer-term momentum confirmed, near-term pullback. PM (+85): FDA modified-risk headline; PM not in detailed timeframe here — monitor price action for confirmation. SCHW (+60): Fed stress-test strength; SCHW not in detailed timeframe here but headline supports Financials theme.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
META (-45): CEO comments on AI reorg; META (1W: +7.37% | 1M: -2.37%) RECOVERY — negative sentiment vs short-term price gain signals distribution risk. BA (-45): IT outage headline; BA (1W: +3.84% | 1M: +4.04%) ABOVE TREND — headline increases event risk despite positive trend.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership as narrow Tech leadership and broad sector breadth conflict. PANW, MA, JNJ showing relative strength (PANW ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND, JNJ ABOVE TREND). Major divergence among Big Tech (many RECOVERY cases) is the key risk—monitor news-driven sentiment (META, JPM) for confirmation or failure.
